title: Project Overview
description: NTPC Warranty Management System - A full-stack web application for managing computer equipment warranty tickets. Built with React 18, Ant Design, Express.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

title: Infrastructure Setup
description: Docker Compose orchestrates 4 services: PostgreSQL database, Express.js backend API, Nginx-served React frontend, and Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for public access.

title: Backend API Architecture
description: Express.js server with modular route handlers and library modules. Routes handle REST endpoints while libs provide authentication, database access, audit logging, and backup functionality.

title: Data Model
description: Prisma schema defines the database models for warranties, staff, suppliers, and audit logs. PostgreSQL provides the relational data store.

title: Frontend Entry Point
description: React application bootstraps from main.jsx, renders App.jsx which sets up routing, authentication guards, and lazy-loaded page components.

title: Admin Dashboard
description: Admin pages for managing warranties, viewing statistics, importing/exporting data, and managing staff and suppliers.

title: Customer Portal
description: Public-facing pages for customers to track warranty status by receipt number. Includes tracking results with timeline visualization.

title: Shared Components
description: Reusable UI components including status tags, customer picker modals, warranty history timeline, and theme toggle.

title: Services & Hooks
description: API service clients (warrantyService, backupService) and custom React hooks (useWarranties, useTheme) provide data fetching and state management.

title: Internationalization
description: Vietnamese language support with i18next. Translation files organized by namespace (ui, status, messages, nav, validation, print).

title: Testing
description: Unit tests using Vitest and Testing Library. Tests cover utilities, components, and i18n functionality.
